recover.noWallet: Connect a wallet before recovering an existing safe.
recover.invalidAppId: Enter a valid Algorand application ID.
recover.invalidName: The selected app did not return a valid Algo Safe name.
recover.loadFailed: Unable to load that application on the selected network.

home.intro: Algo Safe is a policy-driven smart account system. Secure your assets with multi-signature workflows, automated rebalancing agents, and granular governance protocols designed for Algorand's resilient blockchain.
home.walletReady: Wallet connected. Your treasury safes are ready.
home.createText: Deploy a fresh institutional treasury with custom signers and automated policies.
home.importText: Enter an on-chain Algo Safe application ID. The dashboard reads the contract name first and only then stores it in your local registry.
home.appIdHint: Use the ID of an already deployed Algo Safe on the currently selected network.
home.empty: No safes yet — create one above.
home.registryLine1: Only safes you deploy or recover in this browser are shown here.
home.registryLine2: Import an existing Algo Safe by app ID, or create a new one to populate the list.

login.intro: Pick the chain you want to work on, then connect a compatible wallet to view existing safes, create new treasuries, and manage policy-driven operations from the authenticated console.
login.secureText: Keep transaction signing inside your wallet while Algo Safe uses the connected account for authenticated actions.
login.walletsText: MainNet and TestNet use browser and WalletConnect wallets, while LocalNet exposes the KMD development wallet.
login.why1: Authenticate before loading safes so the dashboard can bind actions to your active Algorand account.
login.why2: Once connected, the existing treasury overview and safe management console become available immediately.
login.why3: LocalNet skips browser wallets in favor of KMD.
login.chooseText: Connect to unlock your authenticated dashboard.
login.chainHint: WalletConnect requires a valid CAIP chain, so choose the target chain before pairing.
login.localnetHint: Use the LocalNet KMD wallet for local development sessions.
login.walletsHint: Use Pera, Defly, WalletConnect, or Biatec Wallet for this Algorand chain.
login.kmd: Use the local KMD wallet managed by AlgoKit LocalNet for development flows.
login.pera: Scan a QR code or approve in-app with Pera.
login.defly: Approve the session in Defly to continue.
login.biatec: Connect Biatec Wallet directly (popup or Liquid Auth) and approve the session.
login.walletConnect: Connect any WalletConnect-compatible Algorand wallet using the shared QR flow.
login.noWallets: No compatible wallet providers are available for the selected chain.
login.connectDefault: Please approve the wallet request and try again.

errors.rejected: The transaction was rejected or could not be submitted.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a safe name before starting the deployment.
errors.walletRequired: A connected wallet is required to deploy and fund the safe.
errors.amountInvalid: Enter a positive ALGO amount for the app account MBR funding.

init.title: Initialize Smart Account
init.intro: Deploy the Algo Safe contract from your connected wallet, then fund the new app account with native ALGO for minimum balance requirements.
init.deployText: Create the Algo Safe application on-chain from the already connected wallet.
init.fundText: Send native ALGO to the new app account for box MBR and bootstrap setup.
init.flowText: The wallet will first sign the app deployment, then approve one grouped request that funds the app account and bootstraps it.
init.nameHint: This name is stored on-chain during application creation.
init.mbrHint: Recommended 2 ALGO so the app can cover box minimum balance and bootstrap operations.

idle.title: Start will deploy first, then request one grouped ALGO funding plus bootstrap transaction.
idle.text: The genesis admin group is created during bootstrap after the app account is funded.

deploying.title: Deployment in progress.
deploying.text: Approve the smart contract deployment in your wallet. The button stays locked until the chain confirms creation.

funding.title: Contract deployed. Step 02 is now in progress.
funding.text: Check your wallet for the grouped signature request that funds the new app account with ALGO and bootstraps the safe.

success.title: Safe initialization completed.
success.text: The contract is deployed, funded with ALGO, bootstrapped for governance, and stored in your local safe registry.

error.title: Initialization stopped.
error.text: Review the error below, then restart the flow when the wallet is ready.

init.fees: Network fees are paid in ALGO and depend on wallet-confirmed transactions.

mock.safeNotFound: Safe {{safeId}} was not found in the local registry.
